action.objective: Reposition king to e2, meeting the check safely and holding the center.
action.rationale: e3e2 is the only commit_ready move: exact depth-2 verification, immediate-mate safety complete, no mating reply, best exact broad-search score (-245) among all legal moves. Qxf1+ exists but the king is the priority after Re2 to avoid the Qh3 pin; other options (f1f3, d1f3) lose material to Bxf3.
